Agent Name: Historian_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Historian_Expert made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the first citation reference link. The agent assumed the first citation (reference [[1]](#cite_note-thb-1)) pointed to the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH) website, whereas the actual link provided in the conversation logs (and visible in the Wikipedia text) points to "Thieme-Becker" (a German biographical dictionary). This fundamental misidentification of the target webpage led the subsequent steps to search for an image on the wrong site, resulting in the failure to find the correct image and the subsequent OCR error. The agent failed to rigorously verify the actual URL of the first citation before proceeding.
